layout_description: Place a wide candidate-action input strip across the top, leading down to a central review box. Fan out from that box into exactly four aligned branches across the lower half. Each branch has a small condition line above a strong action label. Only the execution branch points down into an action-commit endpoint. The block branch ends at a separate stop-submission endpoint. Draw a dashed return connector from re-planning around the left outer margin into the review box; it must not point directly into execution. The human-review branch is an independent endpoint with no automatic execution arrow. The footer is a separate common-outcome annotation applying to every initial task, not a fifth decision branch. Avoid crossing any arrow through text. Make the four decisions visually equal in size while clearly distinguishing forward execution from the dashed recheck loop.
RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render only exact_* fields; no global title.
All boxes WHITE fill, colored borders only.
Geometric structural visual anchors, no pictorial icons.
Solid forward arrows; dashed recheck arrows.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning icons, NO 3D rendering.
No gradients, shadows, fabricated data or results.
Keep all labels and arrowheads inside safe margins.
caption_note: R3：回答发送、工具执行与记忆写入在提交前统一检查。已授权低风险动作继续执行，可修正风险重规划，明确越权或不可安全修正时阻断，规范不确定时转人工；修订动作再次检查。
参数、样本规模、完整统计公式及事实缺口说明保留正文；图内不作实验完成声明。

completeness.source_excerpt: \textbf{面向研究内容三的监测干预路线。}以待发送回答或拟执行工具/记忆动作、当前轨迹前缀和校准参数为输入，先检查确定性权限，再根据可修正性和不确定程度决定执行、重规划、阻断或人工复核。每次干预后重建对应运行分支，追踪任务完成与风险后果；只有重新通过检查的动作才允许提交。通过与事后检查、仅规则保护和统一拒绝比较，检验风险下降、误阻断和人工负担，输出可运行原型与分场景建议。新发现的问题可用于下一版本开发，但不能回填当前测试版本以改变既有结论。
